rows.summary: Now: a Word paragraph in a custom list style whose numbering is only in word/styles.xml is a list item at its style's level, read through the styles it is based on (a loop, and a chain past 20 links, end). The paragraph's own w:numPr stands over the style's (its ilvl and its numId each; a numId of 0 is no list, on a paragraph or on a style); Word's built-in List Bullet / List Number names stay the fallback; the numbering a Heading style carries stays a heading, not a bullet; a table row with such a paragraph in a cell is left a line a paragraph, as one with its own numPr is. A styles part that cannot be read costs those lists, not the import. Fail-first run 37419313576: 8 tests fail without the fix, all pass with it; related tests 283/283 (run 37419298989).

Now: EditorAlerts and EditorModeBar are memo components, and the Editor hands them handlers that keep their identity and call the latest ones (useStableActions: the two Dismiss buttons and the tab picker) and the store's persistReason ('full' or 'blocked') in place of its error object, so a keystroke in a bullet, the summary or a personal-info field (signed out or signed in), and the write that follows it, render neither. An export error, a storage-full notice, an import notice and the open tab still update them, and a handler held since the first render acts on the latest address and the latest window width. tests/pdf/173 mounts both as the page builds them and credits each in its render count. Fail-first run 37420446631: 12 tests fail without the fix, all pass with it.

issues: No second reader reviewed this branch (the batch's rules do not allow one). My own review found four of my new tests in 173 reading the router's address before the router had applied it (fixed by a7019ed5) and no defect in src.

DESIGN CALLS (mine). W1: docxStyles(styles.xml) is a new export and docxXmlLines(xml, links, styles) takes it as a third argument; a call with two reads as before (the seeded differential test in tf-redos-import-docx passes). A paragraph's ilvl and numId are each its own numPr's, else the style chain's, else (ilvl only) the built-in name's number less one. The brief's 'bullet-or-number' mapping does not exist in the importer: a paragraph's own numPr was only ever 'a list item at level ilvl', shown as a bullet, and word/numbering.xml is never read, so a numbered list still imports as bullets; I reused exactly that mapping. Behaviour beyond the row: a numId of 0 on a paragraph's own numPr now means no list (a List Bullet paragraph with its bullet switched off imported as a bullet before). word/styles.xml is read best-effort so a damaged one cannot fail a working import. The table-row joiner now asks the same question as the line reader. W2: EditorAlerts keeps the prop name persistError (tests/pdf/99 passes it); it now receives store.persistReason, so a failed write that gives the same reason renders nothing. HISTORY: I pushed 35f04b10 before restructuring its test and a force push is forbidden, so W1's test is in two commits (1940ac2a makes each case read a .docx built in the test, so it fails by what the import does and not by the missing docxStyles export; failfirst on 35f04b10 runs it against the branch head); W2 has the same shape (8af5b7d3, then tests only). NEW BUGS SEEN, NOT FIXED: (1) by reading the code, not reproduced: a Word paragraph with a tracked paragraph-format change (w:pPrChange) reads the OLD properties' numPr, because the paragraph-properties pattern in docxXmlLines ends at the first closing w:pPr, the inner one, so a bullet un-bulleted with Track Changes on still imports as a bullet; (2) a document whose default paragraph style (Normal) carries a list: paragraphs with no pStyle are not read as list items (deliberate: they would all become bullets); (3) accessibility, deferred and not worked: EditorModeBar's tabs are plain buttons with no role=tab or aria-selected, the Design toggle has only a title (no aria-pressed or label), and every alert's button reads just 'Dismiss'.
